// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

fn ml_streq(a: *const u8, b: *const u8) -> bool {
    let mut i = 0usize;
    loop {
        let (x, y) = unsafe { (*a.add(i), *b.add(i)) };
        if x != y { return false; }
        if x == 0 { return true; }
        i += 1;
    }
}

fn ml_strout(src: *const u8, buf: *mut u8, cap: i32, needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    // Pass 1: count to the NUL, inclusive. `n` ends at >= 1 for every string.
    let mut n: i32 = 0;
    loop {
        let b = unsafe { *src.add(n as usize) };
        n += 1;
        if b == 0 { break; }
    }
    unsafe { *needed = n; }
    // Truncation is a FAILURE, not a short success (Q12). Nothing has been
    // written, and nothing will be.
    if cap < n { return -1; }
    // Pass 2: copy, terminator included.
    let mut i: i32 = 0;
    while i < n {
        unsafe { *buf.add(i as usize) = *src.add(i as usize); }
        i += 1;
    }
    0
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_carrier_name(scac: *const u8, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    if ml_streq(scac, b"UPSN\0".as_ptr()) {
        return ml_strout(b"UPS Ground\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    if ml_streq(scac, b"FDEG\0".as_ptr()) {
        return ml_strout(b"FedEx Ground\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    if ml_streq(scac, b"DHLE\0".as_ptr()) {
        return ml_strout(b"DHL Express\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    if ml_streq(scac, b"SELF\0".as_ptr()) {
        return ml_strout(scac, ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    if ml_streq(scac, b"NONE\0".as_ptr()) {
        return ml_strout(b"\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    return 1;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_carrier_label(scac: *const u8, tier: *mut i32, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    if ml_streq(scac, b"UPSN\0".as_ptr()) {
        unsafe { *tier = 1i32; }
        return ml_strout(b"UPS Ground\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    unsafe { *tier = 0i32; }
    return ml_strout(b"Unassigned\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
}

// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_commission(amount: f64, tier: *mut i32) -> f64 {
    if (amount < 1000000.0f64) {
        unsafe { *tier = 1i32; }
        return (amount * 0.03f64);
    }
    if (amount < 5000000.0f64) {
        unsafe { *tier = 2i32; }
        return (amount * 0.05f64);
    }
    unsafe { *tier = 3i32; }
    return (amount * 0.07f64);
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_commission_checked(amount: f64, tier: *mut i32, out_value: *mut f64) -> i32 {
    if (amount < 0.0f64) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (amount < 1000000.0f64) {
        unsafe { *tier = 1i32; }
        unsafe { *out_value = (amount * 0.03f64); } return 0;
    }
    unsafe { *tier = 3i32; }
    unsafe { *out_value = (amount * 0.07f64); } return 0;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_count_bounded(n: i32, cap: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut i = 0i32;
    while ((i < n) && (i < cap)) {
        i = (i + 1i32);
    }
    return i;
}

=== deduction ===

// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

const ML_INTEGRAL: f64 = 9007199254740992.0;
fn ml_trunc_raw(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x != x { return x; }
    if x >= ML_INTEGRAL || x <= -ML_INTEGRAL { return x; }
    (x as i64) as f64
}
// Carry x's sign onto a zero result: IEEE gives a product the XOR of the operand
// signs, so `x * 0.0` is exactly "zero with x's sign". Without this, ceil(-0.5)
// would be +0.0 and C would disagree (DP-R3).
fn ml_sz(r: f64, x: f64) -> f64 { if r == 0.0 { x * 0.0 } else { r } }
fn ml_floor(x: f64) -> f64 { let t = ml_trunc_raw(x); ml_sz(if t > x { t - 1.0 } else { t }, x) }
fn ml_ceil(x: f64) -> f64 { let t = ml_trunc_raw(x); ml_sz(if t < x { t + 1.0 } else { t }, x) }
fn ml_round(x: f64) -> f64 { let t = ml_trunc_raw(x); if t != t { return t; } let d = x - t; ml_sz(if d >= 0.5 { t + 1.0 } else if d <= -0.5 { t - 1.0 } else { t }, x) }
fn ml_trunc(x: f64) -> f64 { ml_sz(ml_trunc_raw(x), x) }

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_deduction(gross: f64) -> f64 {
    return ml_floor((gross * 0.045f64));
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_fl(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return ml_floor(x);
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_ce(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return ml_ceil(x);
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_ro(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return ml_round(x);
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_tr(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return ml_trunc(x);
}

#[panic_handler]
fn ml_panic(_: &core::panic::PanicInfo) -> ! { loop {} }

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_boxes(qty: i32, per_box: i32) -> i32 {
    return { let __d = per_box; if __d == 0 { 0i32 } else { (qty).wrapping_div(__d) } };
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_loose(qty: i32, per_box: i32) -> i32 {
    return { let __d = per_box; if __d == 0 { 0i32 } else { (qty).wrapping_rem(__d) } };
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_boxes_checked(qty: i32, per_box: i32, out_value: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    if (per_box == 0i32) {
        return 1;
    }
    unsafe { *out_value = { let __d = per_box; if __d == 0 { 0i32 } else { (qty).wrapping_div(__d) } }; } return 0;
}

// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

fn check_qty(qty: i32) -> Result<i32, i32> {
    if (qty < 1i32) {
        return Err(1);
    }
    if (qty > 10000i32) {
        return Err(1);
    }
    return Ok(qty);
}

fn safe_div(a: f64, b: f64) -> Result<f64, i32> {
    if (b == 0.0f64) {
        return Err(2);
    }
    return Ok((a / b));
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_unit_price(total: f64, qty: i32, out_value: *mut f64) -> i32 {
    let q = match check_qty(qty) { Ok(__v) => __v, Err(__e) => return __e };
    match safe_div(total, (q as f64)) {
        Ok(__v) => {
            unsafe { *out_value = __v; } return 0;
        }
        Err(__e) => { return __e; }
    }
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_line_check(qty: i32, tier: *mut i32, out_value: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    let q = match check_qty(qty) { Ok(__v) => __v, Err(__e) => return __e };
    unsafe { *tier = 1i32; }
    unsafe { *out_value = q; } return 0;
}

fn ml_panic(_: &core::panic::PanicInfo) -> ! { loop {} }

// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

fn ml_streq(a: *const u8, b: *const u8) -> bool {
    let mut i = 0usize;
    loop {
        let (x, y) = unsafe { (*a.add(i), *b.add(i)) };
        if x != y { return false; }
        if x == 0 { return true; }
        i += 1;
    }
}

fn ml_strout(src: *const u8, buf: *mut u8, cap: i32, needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    // Pass 1: count to the NUL, inclusive. `n` ends at >= 1 for every string.
    let mut n: i32 = 0;
    loop {
        let b = unsafe { *src.add(n as usize) };
        n += 1;
        if b == 0 { break; }
    }
    unsafe { *needed = n; }
    // Truncation is a FAILURE, not a short success (Q12). Nothing has been
    // written, and nothing will be.
    if cap < n { return -1; }
    // Pass 2: copy, terminator included.
    let mut i: i32 = 0;
    while i < n {
        unsafe { *buf.add(i as usize) = *src.add(i as usize); }
        i += 1;
    }
    0
}

const ML_INTEGRAL: f64 = 9007199254740992.0;
fn ml_trunc_raw(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x != x { return x; }
    if x >= ML_INTEGRAL || x <= -ML_INTEGRAL { return x; }
    (x as i64) as f64
}
// Carry x's sign onto a zero result: IEEE gives a product the XOR of the operand
// signs, so `x * 0.0` is exactly "zero with x's sign". Without this, ceil(-0.5)
// would be +0.0 and C would disagree (DP-R3).
fn ml_sz(r: f64, x: f64) -> f64 { if r == 0.0 { x * 0.0 } else { r } }
fn ml_floor(x: f64) -> f64 { let t = ml_trunc_raw(x); ml_sz(if t > x { t - 1.0 } else { t }, x) }

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_is_big(n: i32, out_value: *mut bool) -> i32 {
    if (n < 0i32) {
        return 1;
    }
    unsafe { *out_value = (n > 100i32); } return 0;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_bump(n: i32, out_value: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    if (n < 0i32) {
        return 1;
    }
    unsafe { *out_value = (n - 7i32); } return 0;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_answer(out_value: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    unsafe { *out_value = 42i32; } return 0;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_pi_ish() -> f64 {
    return 3.5f64;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_span(n: i32, lo: *mut i32, hi: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    unsafe { *lo = (n - 1i32); }
    unsafe { *hi = (n + 1i32); }
    return n;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_split(x: f64, whole: *mut f64, negative: *mut bool) -> f64 {
    unsafe { *whole = ml_floor(x); }
    unsafe { *negative = (x < 0.0f64); }
    return (x - ml_floor(x));
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_grade(n: i32, tier: *mut i32, out_value: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    if (n < 0i32) {
        return 1;
    }
    unsafe { *tier = 1i32; }
    unsafe { *out_value = (n * 10i32); } return 0;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_code_of(s: *const u8, out_value: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    if ml_streq(s, b"ODD\0".as_ptr()) {
        return 2;
    }
    if ml_streq(s, b"KR\0".as_ptr()) {
        unsafe { *out_value = 82i32; } return 0;
    }
    unsafe { *out_value = 0i32; } return 0;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_tag(n: i32, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    if (n < 0i32) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (n > 100i32) {
        return ml_strout(b"BIG\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    return ml_strout(b"SMALL\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
}

// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_sum_to(n: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut total = 0i32;
    let mut i = 1i32;
    while (i <= n) {
        total = (total + i);
        i = (i + 1i32);
    }
    return total;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

fn ml_streq(a: *const u8, b: *const u8) -> bool {
    let mut i = 0usize;
    loop {
        let (x, y) = unsafe { (*a.add(i), *b.add(i)) };
        if x != y { return false; }
        if x == 0 { return true; }
        i += 1;
    }
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_vat_rate(country: *const u8) -> f64 {
    if ml_streq(country, b"KR\0".as_ptr()) {
        return 0.1f64;
    }
    if ml_streq(country, b"JP\0".as_ptr()) {
        return 0.08f64;
    }
    if ml_streq(country, b"DE\0".as_ptr()) {
        return 0.19f64;
    }
    return 0.0f64;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_issuer_of(bin: *const u8) -> i32 {
    if ml_streq(bin, b"4\0".as_ptr()) {
        return 1i32;
    }
    if ml_streq(bin, b"51\0".as_ptr()) {
        return 2i32;
    }
    return 0i32;
}

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_is_export_item(code: *const u8) -> bool {
    return (!ml_streq(code, b"DOM\0".as_ptr()));
}
